verdict.rationale: An agency offering employer e-filing and payment services could plausibly publish official SDKs, so this story applies. The evidence contains no SDK documentation. Probes found no OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt, and the transactional portal returned 403. FSET and EFT are electronic filing and payment channels, not SDKs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
